title: Energy as a Service-Level Objective: Transaction-Level Energy Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.32731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Service engineers assess every change against functional requirements and qualities such as reliability, performance and availability. Energy is rarely part of this assessment. When consumption rises after a change, the team cannot tell whether the increase is worth investigating, worth accepting, or neither. A change to tracing, retries or a shared component can affect consumption far beyond the modified component. This thesis asks how energy objectives can become actionable engineering instruments rather than reporting metrics. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) answered a similar question for reliability with service-level indicators, objectives and response policies. We take SRE as the guiding research vision and study where the analogy holds for energy and where it breaks. translated_title: 作为服务水平目标的能耗：事务级能耗归因
translated_abstract: 服务工程师在评估每一项变更时，都会对照功能性需求以及可靠性、性能和可用性等质量属性，而能耗很少成为这一评估的一部分。当某项变更导致消耗上升时，团队无法判断这一增长是否值得调查、是否可以接受，或两者皆非。对追踪、重试或共享组件的修改，其影响可能远远超出被修改组件本身的能耗范围。本论文探讨如何使能耗目标成为可操作的工程工具，而非仅仅作为报告性指标。站点可靠性工程（SRE）通过服务水平指标、服务目标与响应策略，已经为可靠性回答了类似的问题。我们以SRE作为指导性研究愿景，研究这一类比在能耗领域何处成立、何处失效。例如，能耗目标可以在规定的工作负载条件下，对每次成功事务的能耗设定上限。本论文将三条研究线索连接成一个整体……
tldr: 本论文借鉴SRE的服务水平目标方法论，提出事务级能耗归因方法，将每次成功事务的能耗作为服务水平目标，使能耗成为可操作的工程评估工具而非单纯的报告指标。
en_tdlr: This thesis adapts the SRE service-level objective methodology to energy, proposing transaction-level energy attribution with energy-per-successful-transaction objectives to make energy an actionable engineering instrument rather than a mere reporting metric.
